risk_note: RV1 paths (notification, app.module) with rule tests (test/spec, RV2 by PR): POST /v1/devices/push-token (reportPushToken) for BR-ID-07 细则「推送令牌与会话」 and the 04 push_tokens row, Codex implementation under ops/approvals.yaml id 30. Only the device's latest login session (last_login_sid read under the device row lock) writes the token value and binding, otherwise the report is ignored with success; same value keeps token_set_at; a later-registered device moves the token, an earlier one takes it back only with a session created after the holder's token_set_at; within push.token_conflict_window_hours (default 24) a fresh move freezes the holder row and nothing is written while frozen; device row first, token rows by ascending id; revoke and acquire in one transaction; 23505 re-read and re-decided at most 3 times; one fingerprinted PUSH_TOKEN_CONFLICT warn per conflict (no raw token). Controller in notification, identity/** untouched. The orchestrator's mechanical commit (Couli-Mechanical: contract-codegen, approvals 31) removed reportPushToken's planned and regenerated route-schemas.gen.ts. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21). The two rule-test commits were squashed into one with the orchestrator's mechanical gitleaks fix (the trace id literal is built from parts; assertions unchanged).
